To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
DS1 recognizes an allotype (Igh-6.2) of the mouse IgMa allele of murine immunoglobulin mu chains, and is specific for the Igh-6 locus.
a mouse monoclonal anti-IgM antibody was derived that binds to a determinant defined by Igh-6, and that this determinant is localized to the CHI domain of the mu chain.
we have produced a mouse monoclonal anti-IgMa antibody (DS1) and used it to demonstrate that the determinant defined by Igh-6 is encoded within the CH1 domain.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an allotypic MAb which recognizes a determinant on the IgM molecule which is controlled by a gene closely linked to the Ig heavy chain locus.
the generation and analysis of a MAb specific for an allotype of mouse IgM.
the genetic analysis and characterization of the DS1 epitope, a determinant of the IgM allotype, using a MAb.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
DS1 is a MAb specific for a murine IgM allotypically defined by an Igh-6 epitope.
DS1 is a MAb specific for the Igha determinant of the CH1 domain.
DS1 is a MAb of Igh-1 specificity, Igh-6, which is reactive with an allotype of the IgMa allele.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the DS1 MAb recognizes a determinant on the Igh-Cb allotype that is controlled by a gene linked to Igh-1 and maps to the CH1 region.
DS1 defines an Igh-6 determinant that is expressed in association with the IgMa heavy chain, but is not expressed in association with IgMb.

the Igh-6 gene complex encodes an IgM-specific determinant in the CH1 domain that is expressed on all IgM-bearing cells in the BALB/c strain, but is expressed on less than 1% of IgM-bearing cells from C57BL/ 6 mice.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we have defined the epitope recognized by the DS1 MAb as being located on the CH1 domain, in the region of the heavy chain that is involved in the binding of IgM to the B cell receptor.

the DS1 MAb can be used as a tool to define the Igh-6 allotype in mice and that the Igh-4, Igh-5, Igh-6, Igh-7 and Igh-8 genes are located in a 0.6 cM interval on mouse chromosome 12, between the D12Mit1 and D12Mit2 markers.
the DS1 epitope (Igh-6.2) is a polymorphic determinant, which is controlled by a gene linked to Igh-6, and which is expressed on the cell surface and in the serum.
